summary: MarsWalk reimagines how humanity can explore the Red Planet by bringing Martian geography, mission navigation, and AI-powered guidance into one interactive platform. With access to over 2,400 Martian regions, route-planning capabilities, and Ruby, an AI exploration companion, users can discover significant locations, understand unfamiliar terrain, and experience Mars through a mission-oriented perspective. Complemented by an immersive 360° exploration experience in development, MarsWalk transforms planetary exploration data into an engaging journey. It aims to make the vast and complex landscape of Mars easier to explore while bringing us one step closer to envisioning humanity's first footsteps on another planet. Also making it easier for students and enthusiasts to explore the planet, understand its landmarks, and engage with mission-style journeys, helps turn scientific information into an interactive experience.
details:
MarsWalk is an interactive Martian exploration and mission-planning platform envisioned to support humanity's first astronauts as they take their first steps on Mars. Designed around NASA's Interplanetary Survival Guide challenge, it brings together interactive maps, route planning, and an AI-powered conversational guide, Ruby, to make Martian exploration more informed, accessible, and engaging.

The platform allows users to explore more than 2,400 Martian regions, including scientifically significant locations such as Jezero and Gale Crater, navigate supported areas, plan exploration routes, and interact with Ruby to understand Martian terrain, geographical landmarks, and mission sites. By presenting exploration information through an integrated interface, MarsWalk aims to help future explorers better understand their surroundings, identify areas of scientific interest, and make more informed decisions while navigating the Martian surface.

The project also incorporates a Unity-based 360° exploration experience with phone-gyroscope interaction, currently in development, offering an immersive perspective of the Martian environment.

Our vision is to bridge the gap between robotic Mars exploration and future human missions by transforming complex planetary data into an interactive exploration and decision-support experience. MarsWalk aspires to help prepare humanity for that historic first step on Mars, where every route, discovery, and decision matters.
